# Global medium-range NWP

Data-driven global weather models for 1 to 15 days, usually trained on reanalysis (ERA5), deterministic or with a single best estimate.

[← All topics](../README.md) · [Search this topic on the site](https://ml4wx.github.io/topics/global-medium-range/)
